verdict.rationale: Vue's reactivity system (reactive/ref) is built-in and can be used to create a simple global store without Vuex/Pinia, but the evidence pack mostly shows Vue's official solution for global state is Vuex, a separate installed library, not a built-in primitive-only approach (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13, vue-comm-19). No direct evidence confirms the reactive()-as-store pattern being documented or endorsed as a no-library solution.
